entry.title: Access status rechecked 14 Oct 2026, 16:46 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime 99.837% (99.838% on 13 Oct) with no new status-page event; the status page now also lists two regional API entries, us-east-1 and us-east-2. Two notices shown as on 13 Oct; the hidden notice on TypeSafe's Jack & Jill case study retired at the end of its seven-day shelf life (the case study stays a vendor lead on benchmarks).

When Jev fails: no-key, bypass and n8n below-threshold cells settled for ticket triage, email and lead sorting, n8n, browser and computer use and three single rows, read at the published pins. No key: 50 fail closed, 17 fall back, 7 fail open, 3 advisory, 0 not recorded (8 before). Bypass recorded for 66 of 77 (52 before); 11 not recorded: judge tools 4, frameworks 3, browser agents 3, email 1. A bypass cell counts as recorded only when every entry point was read.

n8n: without a credential, each of the 5 Jev nodes stops with n8n's 'Node does not have any credentials set' error when Continue On Fail is off (n8n release 2.44.1); with it on, the item goes to an error or review output, carries an error field, or passes through unchanged, depending on the node.

Python: typesafe-sdk 0.7.4 (released 9 Oct) keeps a 10 s timeout and 2 retries on 408, 429 and 5xx within 30 s; a missing key raises TypeSafeError when the client is created. Example pins moved to 0.7.4; older version notes collected in one dated list. New title: Jev Python SDK (TypeSafe AI).

TypeScript: ai 7.0.140 renamed experimental_evaluate to experimental_decide (the old name still works as a deprecated alias); with @ai-sdk/typesafe-ai 3.0.18 a missing key throws LoadAPIKeyError at the first call; @typesafe-ai/sdk 0.6.0 throws at client creation. One version block and a dated list of earlier checks.

Benchmarks: B44 graded A (48-game Tetris round robin: Microsoft-Decision-1 won 15, Jev 12, OpenAI's Decisions API 11, Laya 8, 2 draws) and B43 graded B (SubQ Snap and Jev level on SWE-bench Verified file localization; the operator takes part in Subquadratic's prize challenge). 41 graded rows (A 12, B 14, C 8, D 7).

Alternatives: SubQ Snap (Subquadratic) added as a hosted decision API with Jev's request shape, $0.05 per 1M input tokens, in public preview; its Terms and its data-retention docs give different retention (both quoted). 34 substitutes; hosted APIs from other providers 4.

Decisions API vs Jev vs Microsoft Decision 1: B44 (grade A, Tetris round robin) added to the graded-tests row and the copyable summary; no price or status cell changed (checked 14 Oct 2026, 16:48 UTC); the SubQ Snap line now links its row on Jev alternatives.
Research report of 14 October 2026: what implementations do with no key, code paths that skip Jev, the Python and TypeScript SDK refresh, B43 and B44, SubQ Snap, and the access recheck.

Evidence notes from 9 October 2026 on Jev rerankers and SQL and document projects reorganised as a topic page: tables of what each implementation does on a Jev error and with no key, the 9 Oct access snapshot, version checks and open questions, with the statements that lack a surviving source link marked. The 9 Oct failure count now points to the current When Jev fails page. Links from the research index, the reranking, SQL and failure pages and the access pages now use the new title.

New page: Jev reranking and document pipelines, evidence notes dated 9 Oct 2026. What five Jev rerankers and context filters and five SQL and document projects did when the Jev call failed, as read in source that day; six more SQL extensions that call Jev (failure paths not read); the 9 Oct access and price snapshot, version checks and OpenRouter route metadata; open questions about jev-approvals, openlayer jevals, pg-redact and rh-guard. Dated observations, not rechecked since.

Access status rechecked 13 Oct 2026, 05:18 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime unchanged at 99.838% with no new status-page event. Two notices shown as on 12 Oct; the hidden notice on Vercel's second Jev provider retired at the end of its seven-day shelf life (the fact is unchanged).

New page: Decisions API vs Jev (TypeSafe AI) vs Microsoft Decision 1, with Cloudflare Clef. Graded results depend on the task: OpenAI's Decisions API ahead on RPG move accuracy (B38); Jev on Portuguese exact judge score (B39); Jev and Microsoft-Decision-1 not separated on routing macro-F1, both ahead of OpenAI (B41). A dated comparison card, full table and copyable summary; no overall ranking.

Benchmarks: B42 (etsabary/luna-decisions-benchmark) graded B with 7 flags; 39 graded rows (A 11, B 13, C 8, D 7). On 1,000 five-option logic questions, Jev answered 817 correctly and OpenAI's Decisions API 612; Jev's answers come from a 22 Sep run, and the answer key is not published.

When Jev fails: no-key and bypass cells settled for model routing and content moderation. No key: 43 fail closed, 16 fall back, 7 fail open, 3 advisory, 8 not recorded (18 before). Bypass recorded for 52 of 77 (44 before). Malformed answers: agent-router is now fail-closed (35 fail-closed, 1 not recorded).

Alternatives: hosted rows rechecked 13 Oct. Microsoft-Decision-1 is listed as Preview in Foundry (Generally available on 12 Oct; cause unknown), with requests-per-minute limits by tier and Product Terms text; OpenAI's Decisions API now has four graded comparisons (B42 added); Clef data goes to the host you pick on OpenRouter. Still 33 substitutes.

Correction: Microsoft-Decision-1 was listed as Preview in Microsoft Foundry at 13 Oct 2026, 05:20 UTC; the Azure pointer said version 1, GA (as read on 12 Oct). Jev is still not listed in Foundry or Amazon Bedrock (13 Oct 2026, 05:20 UTC).

Research report of 13 October 2026: decision-API comparison page, B42, the Foundry lifecycle change, the no-key and bypass pass for model routing and content moderation, comparator review, and the access recheck.

Access status rechecked 12 Oct 2026, 05:12 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime unchanged at 99.838% with no new status-page event. Two notices shown as on 11 Oct; none retired.

New page, Jev plays Doom: real-time game and robot demos. Of 3 published game and robot-simulation demos that call Jev, read at pinned commits, 2 keep their last action when a call fails (doom-jev, JevPlaysSnakeGame) and 1 stops (jev-robotics-demo); none is a product. ra2web (local substitute by default) and llm-invaders (research harness) listed, not counted.
